articles.title: SMRs could be part of Port of Rotterdam's future, says study
articles.summary: The Dutch port of Rotterdam could become part of the future small modular reactor supply chain - with opportunities extending well beyond the adoption of nuclear technology itself, according to a study conducted jointly by Tractebel and Technopolis Group.

articles.title: Viewpoint: Four million workers won't be enough without the right leaders
articles.summary: Who will lead the tripling of nuclear capacity? Isis Leslie, Head of Leadership and Capacity Development at World Nuclear Association, looks at what the next generation of nuclear leaders will need and how the industry can develop them through World Nuclear University.

articles.title: ASEAN nations assessing nuclear energy option
articles.summary: Southeast Asian countries are taking a pragmatic look at nuclear power as they seek to meet rapidly growing electricity demand, strengthen energy security and diversify their power generation mix, delegates heard at the World Nuclear Supply Chain conference in Manila.

articles.title: Westinghouse invests USD1 billion in US LEU+ fuel plant
articles.summary: Westinghouse has announced a USD1 billion investment in the first new fleet-scale nuclear fuel factory to be built in the USA in more than 50 years, at the Columbia Fuel Fabrication Facility in Hopkins, South Carolina.

articles.title: The Nuclear Company proposes 6.6 GW Kentucky project
articles.summary: The Nuclear Company has outlined plans for an energy campus in Lewis County, Kentucky, which could feature up to six AP1000 reactors - this would make its 6.6 GW capacity larger than any current nuclear power plant in the USA.

articles.title: IAEA says Barakah drone-strike response was effective
articles.summary: An International Atomic Energy Agency mission to the United Arab Emirates has said that effective action was taken following the loss of off-site power to Barakah Nuclear Power Plant's unit 3 following a drone strike in May which caused a fire in a generator located outside the inner perimeter of the plant.

articles.title: Westinghouse To Invest $1 Billion In New US Higher Enrichment Nuclear Fuel Facility
articles.summary: Westinghouse Electric Company has announced an investment of approximately $1bn (€890m) in a new manufacturing facility for low-enriched uranium plus (LEU+) nuclear fuel at its existing Columbia fuel fabrication site in South Carolina, a statement said. The company said construction has begun at the site near Hopkins. Production is scheduled to start in 2030.

articles.title: Philippines advances plans for nuclear power as energy demand rises
articles.summary: The Philippines is working to establish the policy, regulatory and commercial foundations for its first nuclear power project, with a target of 1.2 GW of capacity by 2032 and a longer-term ambition to reach 4.8 GW by 2050, the World Nuclear Supply Chain conference in Manila heard.

articles.title: Aura aims for final investment decision on Mauritania project this year
articles.summary: Aura Energy Limited says it is targeting a final investment decision by the end of the year for the Tiris uranium project in Mauritania as a newly released bankable feasibility study confirms the project's economics. But Deep Yellow says current equity market conditions don't support a final investment decision for its Tumas project in Namibia during the current quarter.

articles.summary: Progress on the Dukovany new nuclear project is continuing on schedule, but South Korea has concerns about the potential impact of the European Union's proposed Industrial Accelerator Act on non-member countries participating in the EU's nuclear power market.

articles.title: Nuclear Industry Calls For Concrete Action In EU Post-2030 Energy Framework
articles.summary: Senior executives from Europe’s nuclear industry have called on the European Commission to take “concrete steps” to support nuclear investments under the EU’s post-2030 energy and climate framework, including a common clean energy target covering both nuclear power and renewables. In a letter dated 19 October to European Commission president Ursula von der Leyen, the executives urged the EU to move away from technology-specific targets and ensure that all low-carbon energy sources receive equal policy support.

articles.title: AEP, Amazon and X-energy planning 12-SMR plant
articles.summary: US utility American Electric Power and X-energy have signed a joint development agreement to evaluate a potential 960 MW project at a former coal plant site in Sullivan County, Indiana.

articles.title: Centrus Announces $116 Million Acquisition Of Centrifuge Component Supplier Westerman
articles.summary: US nuclear fuel company Centrus Energy has acquired Westerman Holdings, a major supplier of components for its uranium enrichment centrifuges, for about $116m (€103m), a statement said. Centrus said the acquisition was financed through about $95m in cash and $21m in equity.

articles.title: Rosatom signs floating nuclear power deal for Indonesia
articles.summary: Electricity generated by floating nuclear power plants will be provided to an East Indonesian island, according to an agreement signed by Rosatom and Indonesian company PT Pembangkit Listrik Nuklir.

articles.title: Oklo plans isotope facility under US Launch Pad initiative
articles.summary: Oklo says the Groves-2 Forge isotope production and processing pilot facility will build on the deployment of its Groves Isotope Test Reactor, which reached criticality earlier this year.

articles.title: Slovakia’s Mochovce-4 Nuclear Power Plant Connected To Grid For First Time
articles.summary: The Mochovce-4 nuclear power plant in Slovakia has been connected to the national electricity grid for the first time, marking a major milestone in the commissioning of the VVER-440 reactor unit. Slovak owner Slovenské Elektrárne said the first of the unit’s two turbine generators was synchronised with the grid at 20:41 local time on 15 October and began supplying electricity.

articles.title: Годовой план по кобальту-60 выполнен в октябре ✅
articles.summary: Курская, Ленинградская и Смоленская АЭС производят изотоп кобальт-60 в реакторах РБМК-1000, одновременно с выработкой электроэнергии. articles.title: МРТ в Волгодонске для маленьких пациентов 🏥

articles.title: Viewpoint: Unlocking ASEAN's nuclear potential - a case for regulatory convergence on SMRs
articles.summary: ASEAN's rising electricity demand and decarbonisation goals are driving interest in small modular reactors, but fragmented national regulatory frameworks, limited expertise and financing uncertainty could delay their deployment, write Ming Tan and Stephanie Liaw of engineering, management and development consultancy Mott MacDonald.

articles.title: Sweden’s Studsvik Signs ‘Landmark’ Spent Nuclear Fuel Agreement With Norway
articles.summary: Sweden-based nuclear services company Studsvik has signed what it called a “landmark” agreement to manage Norway’s legacy spent nuclear fuel. The agreement with Norwegian Nuclear Decommissioning (NND), the Norwegian state agency responsible for decommissioning the country’s nuclear facilities, runs until 2055 and has an estimated contractual minimum value of about SEK 875m (€78m, $88m) and a potential total value for Studsvik of SEK 3-4bn.

articles.title: Norwegian used fuel to be stored in Sweden
articles.summary: Norwegian Nuclear Decommissioning has signed an agreement with Swedish nuclear technical services provider Studsvik to manage used nuclear fuel from the former research reactors at Halden and Kjeller.

articles.title: Thorizon, TNO launch MSR materials programme
articles.summary: Molten salt reactor developer Thorizon and Dutch research and technology organisation TNO have launched a materials and corrosion programme to generate the experimental data and predictive models required to qualify materials for molten salt reactors.

MHI delivers replacement steam generators for French reactor
articles.summary: Japan's Mitsubishi Heavy Industries has delivered a further three replacement steam generators to EDF. They are scheduled to be installed in unit 2 of its Cruas nuclear power plant in southeastern France.

articles.title: Milestone for Bruce 4 refurbishment
articles.summary: Installation of the unit's 480 calandria tubes was completed faster than at Bruce 3 as the team carrying out the Major Component Replacement project continues to set new records for CANDU refurbishment.

articles.title: Maritime Nuclear Startup Bluecore Buys First Uranium For Nuclear Plants On Barges
articles.summary: Bluecore Energy, the Long Beach, US-based floating nuclear power startup, has bought its first supply of uranium hexafluoride (UF6), a low-enriched 4.95% blend of U-235 suitable for a commercial nuclear power installation. The material is being held at a US nuclear fuel facility outside the state of California while Bluecore advances its plans for future fuel fabrication, testing and validation. UF6 is the required form of uranium during the enrichment stage of the nuclear fuel cycle.

articles.title: IAEA Training Centre Builds Practical Skills for Nuclear Security
articles.summary: The IAEA’s Nuclear Security Training and Demonstration Centre, the world’s first international training centre dedicated to enhancing nuclear security, opened its doors in Seibersdorf, Austria, in October 2023.

articles.title: Bangladesh’s Rooppur-1 Nuclear Plant Achieves First Criticality
articles.summary: Unit 1 at the Rooppur nuclear power station being built by Russia in Bangladesh has achieved criticality with grid connection expected by the end of November. The 1,080-MW VVER V-523 pressurised water reactor unit, construction of which began in 2017, achieved first criticality at 15:34 on 11 October. First criticality is the milestone moment when a nuclear reactor achieves a self-sustaining, controlled chain reaction for the very first time. Rooppur, Bangladesh’s most expensive infrastructure facility, has considerable backing from Russia.

articles.summary: China’s Linglong-1 small modular reactor (SMR) demonstration plant is undergoing hot functional testing, according to unconfirmed reports in local media. The local China News Service reported that the workers at the plant, under construction at the Changjiang nuclear power site in Hainan province in south China, were aiming to meet targets for fuel loading and grid connection before the end of 2026.

articles.title: Constellation To Invest $4.3 Billion In New Nuclear Capacity After Deal With Google
articles.summary: Google and Constellation Energy have announced a long-term collaboration to bring 890 MW of new nuclear capacity onto the grid to meet growing demand and increase grid reliability. The 20-year power purchase agreement will enable investments in new equipment and technology at 11 Constellation-owned nuclear units in Illinois, Pennsylvania, and New Jersey, increasing thermal and electrical efficiency to unlock additional reliable, firm power to serve the grid.

articles.title: Europe Delivers Final Vacuum Vessel Section For €22 Billion Iter Fusion Project
articles.summary: Europe’s final vacuum vessel section for the International Thermonuclear Experimental Reactor (Iter) nuclear fusion project in France has arrived onsite. Fusion for Energy (F4E), the European Union’s organisation for Europe’s contribution to the €22bn ($24.6bn) Iter project, said the component left Westinghouse’s factory in Monfalcone, Italy, and was transported by French industrial conglomerate Daher to the site in Cadarache.
